title: Building GTA but It's the real world and you can play in real cities.
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Can't believe we live in a time where AI tools like opus 5.5 enable us to create our dream games that wouldn't be possible without AI!

Always dreamed of a GTA Online type of game but with much more depth and funny things to do so I'm working on this already for a while. 

You can even create your own cars / buildings and live in real adresses! The world never sleeps and all NPCs are AI agents. 

It's online and playable in the browser (mobile is still a bit laggy though) 

Built with three.js using claude code and codex.

Would love to hear your opinion and find cool people to build a community with around this!

Play here: [https://theflairgame.com/](https://theflairgame.com/)

comments.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
comments.body:
I honestly love where we are at with AI capability.  10 years ago I could only dream of things like that (not that I'd make a GTA clone, but you get the point) being able to have a playable, buggy SKELETON of a complete game to then spend months polishing in a single day is insane.  Yes, you still have to know what you are doing to get anywhere near "ship it" worthy, but that timeline has gone from 1+ year to a few months.

  
As for the comments below about ripping off another game's vision.. I think most original ideas in 2026 have already been taken.. everything is some variation of different ideas mixed together.  The key is still "making it your own" by giving your game some unique identity (which I think you did with your art style) Nice work!

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: You are so right! Also can't believe that the tech is moving so crazy fast. Just today I also read that google starts removing the standard search feature in the search engine (because of AI) and this one was a crazy thing for years everyone used and is already outdated now
